_comment: Feature catalogue. Same variable and same unit on the target (Moon/Mars) side and the Earth side. 'kind': numeric | categorical | ordinal. 'derived': computed by pipeline/compute_scores.py, never typed in by hand. 'context_only': shown on the detail view, never scored.

features.label: Slope
features.tooltip: How steep the ground is, in degrees. 0° is flat.
features.earth_method: Median slope within ~1 km of the site from a 30 m DEM (NASADEM below 60°N, ASTER GDEM above).
features.caveat: Native ~30 m Earth DEM. No longer used for scoring: SkyFall now compares slope at 200 m on both sides.

features.label: Surface roughness
features.tooltip: How bumpy the ground is: standard deviation of elevation in a small window.
features.earth_method: Standard deviation of elevation in a 3×3 window of the 30 m DEM, median within ~1 km.
features.caveat: Native ~30 m Earth DEM. Not used for scoring (no matching Mars value at this scale).

features.label: Slope (240 m)
features.tooltip: Slope measured on a 240 m grid on BOTH sides, so the Moon and Earth are compared at the same scale.
features.earth_method: DEM average-resampled to a 240 m local metric grid (same code as the Moon side), median slope within 5 km (pipeline/fetch_real_data.py).
features.target_method: LOLA LDEM_75S_240M polar DEM, median slope within 5 km of the site position.
features.caveat: 240 m is far coarser than a landing pad: it describes the regional terrain, not the exact touchdown spot.

features.label: Roughness (240 m)
features.tooltip: Bumpiness on a 240 m grid on both sides: elevation spread around the local tilt.
features.earth_method: DEM average-resampled to a 240 m local metric grid (same code as the Moon side), 3×3 detrended standard deviation, median within 5 km.
features.target_method: Same calculation on the LOLA 240 m DEM.
features.caveat: The LOLA 240 m DEM is interpolated between laser tracks, which can smooth it slightly more than Earth DEMs.

features.label: Slope (200 m)
features.tooltip: Slope on a 200 m grid on BOTH sides (Mars HRSC-MOLA DEM and Earth DEM). Coarse-scale screening only.
features.earth_method: Earth DEM average-resampled to a 200 m local metric grid; median slope within 5 km (pipeline/fetch_real_data.py).
features.target_method: Mars MGS MOLA – MEX HRSC blended DEM (200 m), same resampling and window.
features.caveat: COARSE-SCALE SCREENING (~200 m), not a landing-safety check: NASA's <15° limit is defined at 1–5 m (HiRISE/CTX DTMs).

features.label: Roughness (200 m)
features.tooltip: Bumpiness on a 200 m grid on both sides: elevation spread around the local tilt.
features.earth_method: Earth DEM average-resampled to 200 m; 3×3 detrended standard deviation; median within 5 km.
features.target_method: Same calculation on the Mars HRSC-MOLA blended DEM (200 m).
features.caveat: The Mars DEM stores whole metres, so Mars roughness below ~0.5 m is near its quantisation limit.

features.label: Rock cover
features.tooltip: Share of the ground covered by rocks. Known for the Mars/Moon side only: Earth has no rock-cover dataset in %, so the Earth value is empty.
features.earth_method: NOT AVAILABLE on Earth: no global rock-abundance dataset exists (no Earth equivalent of Mars TES/THEMIS or LRO Diviner rock abundance). Texture proxies (DEM roughness, ASTER GED emissivity, Landsat texture) are not in % and cannot be converted without field calibration, so Earth stays null/TODO.
features.caveat: Earth value is null on purpose. The weight is renormalised over the other features and the SkyFall rock-cover hard filter is not applied to Earth sites.

features.label: Regolith / soil type
features.tooltip: What the loose surface layer is made of (e.g. fine impact dust, volcanic ash, ice-rich mantle).
features.earth_method: US sites: dominant soil component from USDA SSURGO/STATSGO (Soil Data Access). Elsewhere: most probable WRB group from ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 (non-NASA, modelled 250 m). Soil class → regolith category with pipeline/context_rules.json (provisional). Classes with no planetary equivalent stay null.
features.caveat: Earth soil classes and planetary regolith types are different classifications; the mapping is a team decision.

features.label: Geology / composition
features.tooltip: Main rock type. Lunar highlands are anorthosite (feldspar-rich); lunar maria and much of Mars are basalt.
features.earth_method: Macrostrat geologic map units at the site (compiles USGS, GSC and other survey maps); most detailed map scale with a recognisable lithology; keywords → category with pipeline/context_rules.json (provisional). More than one category at that scale → 'mixed'.

features.label: Temperature swing
features.tooltip: Difference between typical day and night surface temperature.
features.earth_method: MODIS LST day minus night, multi-year mean (or ASTER L2 day/night pairs).
features.caveat: Lunar and Martian swings are far larger than anything on Earth; this feature ranks Earth sites by relative behaviour only.

features.label: Relative cold
features.tooltip: How cold the Earth site is compared with the other Earth candidates (1 = coldest). Used for the Moon because Earth cannot reach PSR temperatures.
features.earth_method: DERIVED by the pipeline: percentile rank of annual minimum land surface temperature (annual_min_lst_K) among Earth candidates.

features.label: Thermal inertia
features.tooltip: How slowly the ground heats up and cools down (J m⁻² K⁻¹ s⁻½). Earth has only the ATI proxy in a different unit, so the Earth value is empty and ATI is shown as context.
features.earth_method: NOT AVAILABLE on Earth in J m⁻² K⁻¹ s⁻½. The ATI proxy (context feature 'ati_proxy', K⁻¹) is a different variable and unit, so it is not compared with Mars. Converting ATI to thermal inertia needs a calibrated thermal model and field data; not done.
features.caveat: Earth value is null on purpose (same-variable, same-unit rule). The SkyFall thermal-inertia hard filter is not applied to Earth sites.

features.label: Highest sun angle
features.tooltip: The highest the Sun ever gets above the horizon at this place. Near the lunar south pole it stays only a few degrees up, so shadows are long.
features.earth_method: DERIVED from latitude: 90° − |latitude| + 23.44° (Earth's axial tilt), capped at 90°.

features.label: Ground ice
features.tooltip: 0 = no ice; 1 = seasonal frost only; 2 = permafrost or ice mixed in soil; 3 = massive ice or buried glacier.
features.earth_method: ESA CCI Permafrost v5 (2023) permafrost fraction of the 1 km cell: ≥10% → level 2 (low confidence if <50%). No permafrost: coldest MODIS 8-day surface temperature <0 °C → level 1 (seasonal frost), else 0. Level 3 (massive ice) needs a cited field study. Rules in pipeline/context_rules.json.
features.caveat: Status 'verify': modelled permafrost at 1 km, not a ground survey. NSIDC GGD318 (needs login) should be used to cross-check.

features.label: Depth to ice
features.tooltip: How far below the surface the ice starts.
features.earth_method: ESA CCI Permafrost v5 (2023) active-layer thickness (modelled, 1 km) where permafrost is present = depth to the permafrost table.
features.caveat: Depth where ice CAN exist, not confirmed ice: dry permafrost (e.g. parts of the Dry Valleys) is ice-poor below the active layer. ALT ≈ 0 m means the model shows almost no thaw.

features.label: Access & comms
features.tooltip: How practical it is to run a test campaign there (access, permits, safety, communications). 1 = easy.
features.earth_method: mean(exp(−airport km / 100), exp(−road km / 10)) from OurAirports (nearest airport with scheduled service) and OpenStreetMap roads (distance band 1/5/25/50 km). Both non-NASA; NASA SEDAC gROADS and VIIRS Black Marble need a login. Scales are provisional team choices.
features.caveat: Access only: communications, permits and safety are not captured.

features.label: Apparent thermal inertia (proxy)
features.tooltip: (1 − albedo) / (day − night surface temperature). A proxy only: different variable and unit from thermal inertia, so it is never scored against Mars.
features.earth_method: MYD11A1 v061 daily LST + MCD43A3 v061 white-sky albedo via AppEEARS (needs Earthdata login).

features.label: Soil class (raw)
features.tooltip: The soil class as the soil map names it, before mapping to a regolith category.

features.label: Map lithology (raw)
features.tooltip: The geological map unit and lithology at the site, before mapping to a geology category.

features.label: Permafrost fraction
features.tooltip: Share of the 1 km cell underlain by permafrost (ESA CCI v5, 2023, modelled).

features.label: Nearest airport
features.tooltip: Distance to the nearest airport with scheduled flights (OurAirports).

features.label: Nearest road (band)
features.tooltip: Smallest search radius (1, 5, 25 or 50 km) that contains a road or track in OpenStreetMap. 100 = none within 50 km.
